items.quote: The gate checks what changed since the base: every rule, every `sloppatrol: <id> - <reason>` marker (a known id, a real reason, no unused marker), and that no deleted rule is still named in the tree. It exits 0 when clean, 1 on a finding, and 2 when it cannot run.
items.what: Says every rule checks only what changed since the base; rules default to scope all and scan every file, only `changed`-scope rules use the base.
